verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Unreal Automation Tool is documented as a system for automating processes "including testing and building games". The engine also runs from the command line, both through commandlets like -run=cook and through launch arguments described as "invaluable for testing". Together these support scripted, CI-style engine runs. However, nothing in the pack describes a unit or integration test framework for game code, a headless (no-render) mode, or test results being reported to CI. missing for 10: documented unit/integration test framework for game code, explicit headless/no-GPU execution mode, CI integration and test result reporting, independent or hands-on corroboration of tests running in CI.
